title: Seven default questions phases 4+5: the dark logo pair lands on WordPress, Joomla and EmDash; no logo shows the site name; uploaded logos are capped at the demo logo's height; a Joomla home with an empty title takes the business name; an unticked WordPress blog page 404s; Joomla bare-number lines never take words; one-edition Joomla and EmDash sites print the written language in html lang
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test apps/tracy-web/test/brief-brand.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/brief-brand-joomla.test.mjs
S5: Read the exit code and the fail/skipped counts of each run.
expect: Every run exits 0 with 0 failures and 0 skipped tests.

The brand step writes the dark logo next to the light one on WordPress (tracy_logo_dark) and Joomla; a profile with nameFallback prints the site name when no logo is uploaded; logoHeight caps the uploaded logo.
A Joomla line that ships a bare number (a module's article id) only ever takes a number.
A Joomla home menu item with an empty title takes the business name; an unticked WordPress blog page is not served.
POST /_host/display-locale writes the label's display-locale file and refuses a bad label or locale.
evidence: 07/10/2026: seven default questions on every template and every CMS (issue #1013 phases 4 and 5, plan tasks/plan-ten-logo-favicon.md), plus bugs found on cowork.tracy.site folded in per plan 3.0c.
fence: Units over fake Apply doors and the WordPress theme PHP harness. Not exercised here: a running Joomla with Claude Cowork 0.24.1, a deployed release, the dev surface.
